hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE" | grep -q '\.py$'; then ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; black --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi

INPUT=$(cat); COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'git commit'; then BLOCKED=0; if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '\.(env|key|pem|p12|pfx|jks)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Attempting to commit sensitive files (.env, .key, .pem, .p12, .pfx, .jks)'; BLOCKED=1; fi; if git diff --cached -U0 | grep -qE '(api[_-]?key|api[_-]?secret|password|token|secret[_-]?key|private[_-]?key|access[_-]?token)\s*[=:]\s*[^\s]{8,}' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'WARNING: Possible hardcoded secret detected in staged changes.'; fi; if [ $BLOCKED -eq 1 ]; then exit 1; fi; fi
